info.name: Outlook Style for Gmail (v2)
info.description:
If you love this style, consider buying me a coffee and use the Paypal donate link. 
Tired of Gmail’s cluttered look? Wish it had that clean, professional Outlook vibe?

Outlookify Gmail transforms your Gmail into a sleek, minimal interface inspired by Outlook.com. This custom style simplifies the layout, adds subtle hover effects, flattens icons, adjusts the search bar, and gives your inbox a modern, productivity-focused feel—without losing Gmail’s power under the hood.

✅ Features:
• Clean Outlook-style blue header and sidebar
• Minimalist folder icons for a streamlined look
• Subtle email hover highlights like Outlook
• Redesigned search bar for a modern touch
• Flatter buttons and reduced visual noise

Bring order to your inbox and make Gmail feel like a productivity tool again—because design should work with you, not distract you.

Keywords: gmail, outlook, theme, blue, modern, email
info.additionalInfo:
This style transforms Gmail into a clean, Outlook-inspired interface with subtle colors, improved navigation, and a professional look.

Designed for desktop Gmail—some elements may shift if Google updates class names.

Light theme recommended (dark mode not supported yet).

Feel free to use the code and update to your own version, make improvements, etc.  You do not need my permission to do so.

Keywords: gmail, outlook, theme, blue, modern, email
